messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off onboarding for Kestrel (enterprise) — they went live with a small pilot last week and want a full rollout in 6 weeks. Main goals: embed search+assistant into support portal, <10% query latency P95, and measure CSAT uplift.

jake_se: Thanks — can you drop the list of technical stakeholders and current infra notes? I can prep the integration checklist.

maria_cs: Tech stakeholders: Sam (Kestrel Eng lead), Priya (infra), Omar (data). Business: Liza (support ops), Ben (product). They currently use GCP us-central, auth via Okta SAML.

oliver_pm: From product: success criteria = 1) assistant answers >= 70% of triage intents correctly, 2) support deflection 15% by week 8, 3) no severe regressions in latency after rollout. Need to agree on eval prompts.

lee_csm: Noted — I'll own week-by-week enablement and playbook handoff. Aya, can you run the enablement schedule?

aya_enable: Yep — proposing two enablement waves: "integrators" (engineers) week 1-2, then "support champions" week 3-4. We should include a train-the-trainer session and a recorded onboarding demo.

sam_exec: FYI from the customer: their renewal is in ~11 months, but they're expecting quick ROI signals. If rollout stalls >2 weeks, renewal conversation risk increases.

maria_cs: Risk acknowledged. Proposed timeline: Week 0 (now) kickoff + SOW confirmation, Week 1-2 infra & auth, Week 3 model tuning + eval, Week 4 internal pilot w/ 25 agents, Week 5 rollout to 200 agents, Week 6 collect metrics and iterate.

jake_se: Integration notes: they want streaming responses and conversation state. Our SDK + webhook flow should work. I'll paste the quick script for the webhook listener:

```python
# minimal listener
from flask import Flask, request
app = Flask(__name__)
@app.route('/webhook', methods=['POST'])
def webhook():
    payload = request.json
    # validate okta assertion, forward to inference endpoint
    return {'status': 'ok'}
```

oliver_pm: Can we lock down the eval set by EOD Friday? Need that to start model tuning.

maria_cs: I'll sync with Kestrel product and support to curate ~120 representative prompts.

lee_csm: Action items: 1) Maria to confirm stakeholder list & SOW (by tomorrow). 2) Jake to share integration checklist + demo app (48h). 3) Aya to publish enablement schedule and materials (3 days). 4) Oliver to finalize eval prompts (EOD Fri). 5) Sam to surface any exec priorities after Monday call.

maria_cs: tagging @jake_se @aya_enable @oliver_pm @sam_exec — please react with :thumbsup: when you own the action.

deploy-bot: Note: Provisioning task #5421 started for kestrel-prod-gpu-pool. ETA ~2h.

jake_se: :thumbsup: I got integration checklist on my todo.

aya_enable: :thumbsup: will create calendar invites.

oliver_pm: :thumbsup: collecting eval prompts now.

sam_exec: I'll join Monday sync and confirm exec ask.

maria_cs: Great — I'll schedule the kickoff call for Monday 10am PT and send calendar invites. Closing loop here for now.
